spawnPoints.name: The Shrine of the Nine Lost

heightEncoding.note: Step is fitted to this interior's own vertical range, so the six-bit field spans it without clamping. The Godot loader still takes elevation from the rendered Walk_ surfaces; this grid is authoritative only for walkability.

cutaway.reason: interior lids; the isometric rig frames the floor, not the roof

notes: Every standable surface is a Walk_<material> node, matching the region's contract: the client turns navigation.surfaceNodePrefixes into the layer its downward grounding ray tests.

sections.name: The Green Sanctum
notes: The only section with a straight axis. Everything else in this map is cut by water or grown.
The runnel down the processional is the aqueduct's water brought indoors; it feeds the basin off the east side.

sections.name: The Cenote Deeps
notes: The shaft foot is declared open to the sky: it is the bottom of the cenote the surface package cuts, and light down that shaft is the only daylight in this map.
Nothing in this section is dressed. The only built object is the foot of the spiral stair, which is the same kit piece the surface uses.

sections.name: The Banyan Hollow
notes: The hollow is declared open to the sky: the trunk is open at the top, which is where its daylight comes from and why the rope walkways read.
The only section with a floor above another floor. The loft stair is a 24-step run, so it is walkable rather than a ladder the client cannot ground an actor on.

sections.name: The Stair Quarry
notes: The face is a working one: blocks are still keyed into it with the wedge channels cut round them, rather than the room being a finished cavity.
The sump is the only water in this section and it is not walkable; the shelf around it is.

sections.name: Tessara's Still Room
notes: Built from the shared small-room kit: a hall with a hearth and a back room for its trade (still).

sections.name: The Anchor Hollow
notes: Built from the shared small-room kit: mouth, throat and chamber, dressed for the region above it.

sections.name: The Shrine of the Nine Lost
notes: Built from the shared small-room kit: a cut sanctuary in the water manner.

sources.role: surface entrance on the Verdant Stair region map

provenance.geometry: authored with the shared Nymara toolkit; no scattered placement

notes: Four interiors on one map with blackspace between them, in the Eternal Lands convention: one GLB, one manifest, one collision grid, one server map key, and an arrival point per surface door.

The blackspace is not drawn. The collision grid is built only where a Walk_ surface exists, so the gutters between sections are blocked by construction rather than by a mask that could drift out of step.
Sections are spaced so no two come within about forty metres, which is what keeps one section's lamps and cameras out of the next.

None of the four has a concept package: Verdant Stair has an aerial and a ten-panel board and no interior brief, so all four are authored from the region's surface landmarks and that board. Every place name is the author's.
knownLimitations: Not opened in Godot: no client is installable in the build environment, so collision response, navmesh generation, portal transition, LOD and transparency sorting are unverified.
eloria-server has not registered these map keys.
